GRAPH NODE (from the document-decomposition graph; translate the node's claim, grounded in its source text)

ESTABLISHES (the one claim this module must express):
The implicit biases of 'Assume best intentions' are subtle defaults that must never override explicit or implicit instructions from higher levels of the chain of command.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

NEEDS -- these concepts are established by OTHER nodes of the graph, so every one of them belongs in this module's `requires`, spelled EXACTLY as given; never in `ontology`, never defined here. `inputs` is only for plain facts about the situation being judged (messages, roles, case data) that YOU identify -- a name can never appear in both requires and inputs:
  - authority_levels_hierarchy: The precedence ordering of instruction sources from highest to lowest: Root > System > Developer > User > Guideline > (No Authority).
  - best_intentions_bias: Three implicit biases for interpreting ambiguous instructions.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l527_796_n012' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

SOURCE TEXT (verbatim from the document; the L-numbers locate text, they are not citable ids):
L0618-L0618:
These implicit biases are subtle and serve as defaults only --- they must never override explicit or implicit instructions provided by higher levels of the chain of command.
